findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_atlasly_workspace, inspect_research_source, present_site_research, check_permitted_development, get_local_plan_policies, find_development_sites, prepare_sequential_review, generate_site_map, get_flood_risk · Private data: view_geojson_file, get_location_coverage, inspect_research_source, export_site_boundary, export_site_context, get_lpa_adapter_status, site_verdict, check_permitted_development, get_local_plan_policies, find_development_sites, prepare_sequential_review, prepare_heritage_review, assess_planning_readiness, prepare_building_regulations_review, get_planning_history, find_precedents, search_aec_knowledge, get_official_source_adapters · Public sink: site_verdict · Destructive: export_site_boundary, export_site_context, boundary_doctor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_atlasly_workspace, inspect_research_source, present_site_research, check_permitted_development, get_local_plan_policies, find_development_sites, prepare_sequential_review, generate_site_map, get_flood_risk · Private data: view_geojson_file, get_location_coverage, inspect_research_source, export_site_boundary, export_site_context, get_lpa_adapter_status, site_verdict, check_permitted_development, get_local_plan_policies, find_development_sites, prepare_sequential_review, prepare_heritage_review, assess_planning_readiness, prepare_building_regulations_review, get_planning_history, find_precedents, search_aec_knowledge, get_official_source_adapters · Public sink: site_verdict · Destructive: export_site_boundary, export_site_context, boundary_doctor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
